scenario_title: Consumer concurrency raised past the DB connection limit
title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-03-22 14:31-18:31: api-gateway: 273 of 382 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-22 14:31 and 2026-03-22 18:31 UTC (peak error ratio 0.93 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.582 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Config change raised {key} {old} -> {new} to drain the usage backlog faster; every consumer thread held a billing-db connection and the database refused new ones.
_templates.remediation: Revert {key} to {old}; size consumer concurrency against db.pool.max_size and RDS max_connections.

culprit.diff:
@@ -99,3 +99,3 @@ consumer.concurrency
 consumer:
-  concurrency: 8
+  concurrency: 64
   # managed by the platform team

rca.macro: Config change raised consumer.concurrency 8 -> 64 to drain the usage backlog faster; every consumer thread held a billing-db connection and the database refused new ones.
rca.remediation: Revert consumer.concurrency to 8; size consumer concurrency against db.pool.max_size and RDS max_connections.

action_items: Add validation bounds and a canary for risky config keys (pool / timeout / retry / flags).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=billing-svc`.
